# `browser-tab cut`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab cut [FLAGS]`

DESTRUCTIVE: reconstruct selected tabs elsewhere, then close the sources

## Flags

### `--selector <json>`

Selector AST as JSON; @<file> or - for stdin

### `--selection <id>`

A current select_tabs selectionId (instead of --selector)

### `--to-window <windowId>`

Transfer into an existing window

### `--new-window <browser>`

Transfer into a new window in this browser

### `--confirm-destruction`

REQUIRED: acknowledge sources will close

### `--mode [m]`

Close policy

**Choices:**

- `after-each-success`
- `all-before-close`

### `--idempotency-key <key>`

Retry-safe: same key replays the stored outcome
